question: What were sales last month?

question: How are sales this month compared with the same days last month?
notes: The current month is incomplete, so compare like-for-like (day 1 to today vs the same days last month).
ground_truth_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(invoice_date) AS today, TRUNC(MAX(invoice_date), 'MM') AS m0 FROM ${fact_sales}) SELECT b.m0 AS month, b.today AS data_until, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.invoice_date BETWEEN b.m0 AND b.today THEN f.net_revenue_amount END), 2) AS month_to_date, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.invoice_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(b.m0, -1) AND ADD_MONTHS(b.today, -1) THEN f.net_revenue_amount END), 2) AS same_days_last_month FROM ${fact_sales} f CROSS JOIN b GROUP BY b.m0, b.today
